examples.text: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo ten'upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ, icchām'ahaṃ, āvuso kālāma, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritun'ti.
ayaṃ kho āḷāro kālāmo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī dīgharattaṃ apparaj'akkhajātiko. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ āḷārassa kālāmassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ.

13302.commentary: (DNa) āḷārikā'ti pūvikā. (JAa) āḷāriko'ti bhattakārako. tasmiṃ khaṇe ahaṃ maddarañño antepure bhattakārakadāso viya homī'ti vadati. (JAa) āḷārike'ti pūvapāke. (DNt) āḷāraṃ vuccati mahānasaṃ, tattha niyuttā'ti āḷārikā, bhattakārā. pūvikā'ti pūvasampādakā, ye pūvam'eva nānappakārato sampādetvā vikkiṇantā jīvanti.

13371.meaning1: name of a Brahman village in Kosala

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.

13372.commentary: (UDa) icchānaṅgalako'ti icchānaṅgalanāmako kosalesu eko brāhmaṇagāmo, taṃnivāsitāya tattha vā jāto bhavo'ti vā icchānaṅgalako.

examples.text: assosuṃ kho icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto, icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
assosuṃ kho icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto, icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.

13375.commentary: (UDa) icchānaṅgalako'ti icchānaṅgalanāmako kosalesu eko brāhmaṇagāmo, taṃnivāsitāya tattha vā jāto bhavo'ti vā icchānaṅgalako.

examples.text: assosuṃ kho icchānaṅgalikā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto, icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.

13376.meaning1: based on want; springing from desire

examples.text: icchānidānā bhavasātabaddhā, te duppamuñcā na hi aññamokkhā, pacchā pure vā'pi apekkhamānā, ime'va kāme purime'va jappaṃ.

13377.meaning1: who is afflicted with desire; who is led astray by longing
13377.commentary: (VINa) icch'āpakato'ti tāya pāpikāya icchāya apakato abhibhūto pārājiko hutvā. (ANa) pāp'iccho icch'āpakato'ti araññe me viharantassa ayaṃ āraññako'ti catupaccayasakkāraṃ karissanti, ayaṃ bhikkhu lajjī pavivitto'ti-ādīhi ca guṇehi sambhāvessantī'ti evaṃ pāpikāya icchāya ṭhatvā tāya eva icchāya abhibhūto hutvā āraññako hoti. (NIDD1a) icch'āpakato'ti icchāya apakato, upadduto'ti attho.

examples.text: mandattā momūhattā aññaṃ byākaroti, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato aññaṃ byākaroti, ummādā cittakkhepā aññaṃ byākaroti, adhimānena aññaṃ byākaroti, samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaroti.
mandattā momūhattā paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, paribhavaṃ paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, aññātu'kāmo paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati

13378.meaning1: bound by desire; imprisoned by longing; caught by want

examples.text: saddhā bandhati pātheyyaṃ, sirī bhogānam'āsayo, icchā naraṃ parikassati, icchā lokasmi dujjahā, icchābaddhā puthū sattā, pāsena sakuṇī yathā'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, idha puriso āgaccheyya rājagahaṃ gantu'kāmo. so taṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, icchām'ahaṃ, bhante, rājagahaṃ gantuṃ, tassa me rājagahassa maggaṃ upadisā'ti.
atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, icchām'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, aḍḍhamāsaṃ paṭisallīyituṃ. n'āmhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā'ti.
nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca paṭicca phasso, icchānidānāni pariggahāni, icchāy'asantyā na mamattam'atthi, rūpe vibhūte na phusanti phassā.

13381.meaning1: desire and greed; longing and desiring

examples.text: chetvā naddhiṃ varattañ'ca, icchālobhañ'ca pāpakaṃ, samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyha, evaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.

13385.meaning1: within the realm of desire; within the sphere of want
13385.commentary: (MNa) icch'āvacarānan'ti icchāya avacarānaṃ, icchāvasena otiṇṇānaṃ pavattānaṃ nānappakārānaṃ kop'āppaccayānan'ti attho.

examples.text: aṅgaṇaṃ aṅgaṇan'ti, āvuso, vuccati. kissa nu kho etaṃ, āvuso, adhivacanaṃ yadidaṃ aṅgaṇan'ti? pāpakānaṃ kho etaṃ, āvuso, akusalānaṃ icch'āvacarānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, yadidaṃ aṅgaṇan'ti.

13386.meaning1: removal of longing; dispelling of desire

examples.text: dhammanisantiyā tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñ'ca dhammanisantiyā avigatapemo. icchāvinaye tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñ'ca icchāvinaye avigatapemo. paṭisallāne tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñ'ca paṭisallāne avigatapemo.
atha kho ye icchiṃsu, te akaṃsu, ye na icchiṃsu, na te akaṃsu, yaṃ icchiṃsu, taṃ akaṃsu, yaṃ na icchiṃsu, na taṃ akaṃsu.

atha kho soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa etadahosi, yaṃ vata no ahosi icchitaṃ, yaṃ ākaṅkhitaṃ, yaṃ adhippetaṃ, yaṃ abhipatthitaṃ, aho vata maṃ samaṇo gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyya, addhā vat'ass'āhaṃ cittaṃ ārādheyyaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇenā'ti
icchitaṃ patthitaṃ tumhaṃ khippam'eva samijjhatu, sabbe pūrentu saṅkappā, cando paṇṇaraso yathā, maṇi jotiraso yathā
saṅgahā [saṅgahe aṭṭhakathāyaṃ icchitapāṭho]

13392.meaning1: to be wished for; to be desired

examples.text: yathā'pi dukkhe vijjante, sukhaṃ nāma'pi vijjati, evaṃ bhave vijjamāne, vibhavo'pi icchitabbako.
yathā'pi uṇhe vijjante, aparaṃ vijjati sītalaṃ, evaṃ tividh'aggi vijjante, nibbānaṃ icchitabbakaṃ.

13395.meaning1: would wish; would desire; would want (to)

examples.text: na attahetu na parassa hetu, na puttam'icche na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ, na iccheyya adhammena samiddhim'attano, sa sīlavā paññavā dhammiko siyā.
disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.
amhe payujjamāne'pi appayujjamāne'pi tuly'ādhikaraṇe uttamapuriso hoti. ahaṃ yajāmi, mayaṃ yajāma. appayujjamāne'pi yajāmi, yajāma. tuly'ādhikaraṇe'ti kim'atthaṃ? mayā ijjate buddho.
yaja'icc'etassa dhātussa ādissa ikār'ādeso hoti yapaccaye pare. ijjate mayā buddho.
yaññe rato'haṃ bho gotama, yaññaṃ yiṭṭhu'kāmo n'āhaṃ pajānāmi, anusāsatu maṃ bhavaṃ, yattha hutaṃ ijjhate brūhi me taṃ.
